WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Congratulations, Pooh! We got everybody un-stuck.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Gratuluji, Pú! Všechny jsme odlepili.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Congratulations to you too. But I'm sorry we got stuck in so much stickiness.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Gratuluji i tobě. Ale mrzí mě, že jsme uvízli v takovém lepkavém nepořádku.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Don't worry, Pooh Bear...
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Neboj se, Medvídku Pú...

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: You'll be more careful next time.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Příště si dáš větší pozor.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: You learned about cleaning up your messes.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Naučil ses, jak si po sobě uklidit nepořádek.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Everybody was pleased that you admitted your mistake.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Všechny potěšilo, že jsi uznal svou chybu.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: I shall check all my honeypots for leaks before I use them.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Zkontroluji všechny své hrnce na med, jestli netečou, než je začnu používat.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Oh, {PlayerName}, is that a grown-up thought?
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Ó, {PlayerName}, je tohle dospělácká myšlenka?

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: I suppose it is, Pooh Bear! But you don't have to be in a hurry to grow up.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Předpokládám, že ano, Medvídku Pú! Ale s dospíváním nemusíš nikam spěchat.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Well, you've grown up so much, {PlayerName}, but you're still the wonderful {PlayerName} I remember. And I should like you to have this to remember our adventures.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: No, ty jsi tak vyrostl/a, {PlayerName}, ale pořád jsi ten úhlasný člověk, kterého si pamatuji. A rád bych, abys měl/a tohle na památku na naše dobrodružství.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Yes, a little soap can be very helpful. And make a party too.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Ano, trochu mýdla může být velmi užitečné. A navíc se z toho dá udělat párty.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: They were? It seems to me that saying what you do is important between friends.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Fakt? Zdá se mi, že přiznat to, co uděláš, je mezi kamarády důležité.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: It seems that watering helps remove these honey spills, but this feather I found is still pretty sticky. We'll have to look for a better solution for un-sticking the Villagers.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Zdá se, že zalévání pomáhá odstranit kaluže medu, ale tohle pírko, co jsem našel/našla, pořád dost lepí. Budeme muset najít lepší řešení, jak vesničany odlepit.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: I know you'll think of something, {PlayerName}. You're clever that way.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Vím, že na něco přijdeš, {PlayerName}. Jsi v tomhle šikovný/á.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Thanks, Pooh. But where could this feather have come from...?
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Díky, Pú. Ale odkud by to pírko mohlo pocházet...?

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Did you give Mr. McDuck a honeypot? This white feather has some gold dust sticking to it.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Dal jsi panu Skrblíkovi hrnec s medem? Na tomhle bílém pírku je nalepený nějaký zlatý prach.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Why yes, I did bring Mr. McDuck some honey.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Ale ano, opravdu jsem panu Skrblíkovi donesl trochu medu.

WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.en: Oh, bother. I hope it didn't make him too sticky.
WinnieDLC_Winnie/Winnie_VLG_Winn_040_VLG.cz: Ach jo. Doufám, že ho to moc neulepilo.
